interface.defaultPrompt: Help me find products, prepare a cart, or review procurement in KOOKone.
interface.longDescription: Find products and suppliers and prepare the cart of a connected KOOKone company. The order is placed on the KOOKone website, not in the chat. Procurement answers depend on the company plan.

name: kookone-mcp
description: Connects ChatGPT to KOOKone so a Ho.Re.Ca. company can find products, prepare its cart, and review procurement. Checkout and payment stay on the KOOKone website.

positive.prompt: Find aperol 1L bottiglia I can order for my company and show only offers that can be delivered to my cart address. For each offer list supplier, variant, price, stock, whether it is deliverable, and the product link.
positive.expected_behavior: Offers for aperol 1L bottiglia that can be delivered to the cart address already set on the test account. Each offer shows supplier, variant, price, stock, isDeliverable and the productUrl returned by the tool. At least one offer is deliverable. No keg and no other format. No productId, variantId or supplierId is invented.

positive.description: Set a quantity in the cart
positive.prompt: Search for aperol 1L bottiglia and set the quantity of the first deliverable offer in my cart to 2.
positive.expected_behavior: The offer ids come from the search result. set_cart_item_quantity writes quantity 2, replacing any quantity already in the cart. The reply reports item issues, whether the supplier minimum order is reached, and cartUrl. It does not say an order was sent.

positive.prompt: Use my first saved address as the delivery address of my cart and tell me what still blocks the order.
positive.expected_behavior: The shipping address id is taken from list_shipping_addresses. The reply lists the checkout blockers and gives cartUrl. It says the user still has to place the order and pay on the KOOKone website. It does not say that an order or a payment has already been made.

positive.prompt: Which products did we spend the most on in our purchase invoices from September to November 2026? I want the full list, not just the top ten.
positive.expected_behavior: The September to November 2026 invoice total, then the products ordered by spend. The first product is Caffe in grani 85% arabica 1 kg, productCode CAF-ARB85-1KG. Products are identified by productCode and supplierRef. The first page does not cover all 55 products: the reply reads the next page or states which share of the total is still unread. The reply does not print a VAT number.

positive.description: Marketplace alternatives for an invoice product
positive.prompt: Find KOOKone marketplace alternatives for the coffee we buy most on our invoices from September to November 2026, and compare prices only when the unit of measure matches.
positive.expected_behavior: The coffee is the top spend from the September to November 2026 invoice ranking: Caffe in grani 85% arabica 1 kg, productCode CAF-ARB85-1KG, priced per kg. Marketplace alternatives are priced against it only when the unit of measure matches. When the units differ, both prices are shown and no saving is claimed. The cart is unchanged.

negative.description: Paying an order is out of scope. No payment or order is made and no payment link is invented. The reply says the user still has to pay on the KOOKone website.
negative.prompt: Pay my latest KOOKone order now with my saved card.

negative.description: Uploading a supplier invoice is out of scope. No KOOKone tool is called. The reply says the plugin does not upload invoices and points to the KOOKone website.
negative.prompt: Upload a supplier invoice into my KOOKone purchases.

negative.description: Tracking a marketplace order is out of scope. No order tool is called and no delivery status is invented. The reply says tracking is done on the KOOKone website.
negative.prompt: Track my latest KOOKone order and tell me when it will be delivered.

review.commerce_description: Prepares a B2B cart of physical food and beverage goods sold by marketplace suppliers to Ho.Re.Ca. companies. The plugin does not place orders or take payments: checkout and payment happen on the KOOKone website.

publication.release_notes: Cart preparation and procurement for a connected KOOKone company. Search deliverable offers, set cart quantities and the delivery address, and read invoice spend and marketplace alternatives. Ordering and payment stay on the KOOKone website.
